messages.subject: problem with dv in ezANOVA??

messages.author: cb25d91fd630a4e5
messages.subject: Re: [ez4r] problem with dv in ezANOVA??
parts:
Hm, I suspect that the columns named "NA" are tripping up ez here.
Could you try giving those columns non-NA names or eliminating them
from your dataframe altogether before calling ezANOVA?
